mapper.select: select ITEM_CODE from SYS_DATADICT_LIST where DICT_CODE = 'VERSION_TYPE' and DEFAULT_VALUE = '1'
mapper.update: update SYS_DATADICT_LIST set DEFAULT_VALUE = '1' where DICT_CODE = 'VERSION_TYPE' and ITEM_CODE = #{type1}
update SYS_DATADICT_LIST set DEFAULT_VALUE = '0' where DICT_CODE = 'VERSION_TYPE' and ITEM_CODE in (#{type2},#{type3})
